name: Escape chutes and controlled-descent devices
description: Fabric or spiral chutes give a fast, non-powered descent from a deck or helideck to a lower level or the sea. They are used where stairs are too slow or too exposed.

gaps.what: Chute length, descent rate and certification
gaps.why: No page read gives a chute descent rate or its certification basis.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a vendor datasheet or the LSA Code and record length, descent rate and approval

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
